notes:
Most of the TRD is well grounded. Components C-1 to C-8, interfaces IF-1 to IF-7, contract CT-1, data D-1 to D-9, security S-1 to S-6, tests T-1 to T-13 and risks R-1 to R-9 trace accurately to feat.prd (AC-1 to AC-23, NFR-1 to NFR-11, B-A*, P-A*, OQ-B*, PQ-*), feat.prototype (DL-1 to DL-4, ST-1 to ST-5, SD-1 and the synthetic CT-1 example: SYN-INV-004, 75, "1250.00"), org.architecture (runtimes, signatures, the JSON string/ISO rule, \"Keep every existing signature; add new functions\"), requirements/ZD-48600.md (org.data_model, customer_mappings, model_dependency_map, routing_map, risk_map, design_library) and memory (D-2026-031, D-2026-044, D-2026-050, L-007, L-011). Design choices (delays.py and risk.py modules, the CT-1 name, date.fromisoformat, thead without a risk class, risk=None placed last, minor version bumps, the escaping and allow-list recommendations) are labelled as agent judgement and invent no facts. Every number I checked (30, 10, 02:00 Asia/Kolkata, Python 3.9, Node.js 22, 2 dp, the prototype figures) appears in a source.

Grounding problems:
1. TQ-12 and the header paragraph still say what api:github returned (GITHUB_TOKEN not configured), with no saved connector response. This is the claim that got the last attempt refused.
2. The TRD template is cited to record:brief, but the wording is only in org.templates.

Completeness and usefulness problem: the workbook action asks for the TRD to be drafted from the \"current architecture\". The brief allows code to be cited as file:<repo>/<path>, and the app files are listed as read and valid. Even so, the TRD leaves the code baseline as eight unresolved checks (V-1 to V-8), when several are answered by files the agent read:
- ap_aging/src/ap_aging/aging.py: days_past_due counts calendar days and clamps to 0 (V-4). bucket_for(30) returns \"31-60\", because days < 30 maps to \"1-30\" (V-5 / R-1, a real boundary inconsistency). Invoices are dicts (V-2).
- ap_portal/src/ap_portal/index.js: formatAmount uses Number(value).toFixed(2), a binary float that conflicts with D-2026-044 (V-6 / R-2). VERSION is '2.3.0' (V-8).

These are hedged as risks instead of stated as cited findings, which weakens the Architect's baseline. The structure fully covers the TRD template, and the traceability to the PRD and prototype is complete and accurate.
